python run_lane.py ost_v62_unified --config minimal_linear --tag diag_linear_v1
python run_lane.py ost_v62_unified --lr 1e-5 --dropout 0.0 --l2 0.0 --tag no_reg_v1

- `diag_linear_v1`: Simplest possible model to verify data pipeline works
- `no_reg_v1`: Remove all regularization in case over-regularization is killing gradients
- `low_thresh_v1`: Lower signal threshold in case predictions exist but aren't crossing trade threshold
